name: ev-charging-station-management-system
description: Software Requirements Specification for EV Charging Station Management System (CSMS) - Release 1.0

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.start: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('node', ['server.js'], { cwd: './backend', stdio: 'inherit' }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: './frontend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
